resources.string_add: Code for one app only. An empty field uses the page code above. The apps draw the forms, the logo and the illustration with their own components, and leave out scripts and anything marked data-site-only. The iOS and Android apps show text, headings, lists and links, without styles or layout. Add <neo-slot name="social_login"></neo-slot> for the social sign-in buttons alone.
resources.string_upd: Guests who open the home page see the splash instead. Members who are signed in still see the home page. Turn it on for the site and for each app. Where an app's splash is off, its guests see the home page blocks from Page builder. The splash is not the launch screen the iOS and Android apps show while they start, which comes from Icon.

HTML of the splash. These placeholders are filled in when it is shown: __logo__ the site logo, __illustration__ the splash illustration, __join_form_in_box__ and __login_form_in_box__ the sign-up and sign-in forms in a box, __join_form__ and __login_form__ the same forms without one, __join_link__ and __login_link__ their addresses, {site_title} the site name. The apps show this code too, unless App code below has their own, and leave out elements with the data-site-only attribute.
How guests see the splash on the site. Preview changes shows the code from the editor before you save it.
Root page for guests (apps whose switch in Designer > Splash was never saved follow it)
